sources.entry: SCM Breeze - Set of shell scripts (for bash and zsh) that enhance your interaction with git. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/scmbreeze/scm_breeze)

summary.one_liner: SCM Breeze is a set of bash and zsh shell scripts that enhance git by providing numbered file shortcuts, a tab-completable repository index, and design-directory linking.
summary.what_it_does: It hooks into bash or zsh and, whenever git status is viewed, stores each modified path in a numbered environment variable (prefix 'e' by default). Those numbers and ranges can then be passed to git aliases such as ga, gd, grs and gco, or to system commands via exec_scmb_expand_args (ge). It provides a repository index built with the c command (git_index) that switches between projects with partial-name and subdirectory tab completion, and can run commands or design-directory setup across all indexed repos. It also includes keyboard bindings for add-and-commit shortcuts, and a 'design' command that keeps per-project design asset folders outside git via symlinks and .git/info/exclude. Configuration lives in ~/.*.scmbrc files, and update_scm_breeze fetches updates.
use_cases: Stage or diff changed files by number instead of typing paths
Quickly switch between many git project directories
Batch-run git commands across all local repositories
Keep design assets like PSD or XCF files out of git while syncing them via Dropbox or rsync
Try git shell enhancements in a Docker sandbox
notable: Numbered file shortcuts: refer to modified files by number, including ranges like 1-10
Repository index with tab completion down into project subdirectories, without learning step
Design directory linking via symlinks, excluded from git through .git/info/exclude
Docker sandbox for trying it without changing host shell config
Customizable aliases, or use your own git aliases while keeping numeric expansion
caveats: Some commands require ruby to be installed
Bash does not set up tab completion for user-defined aliases; zsh needs no_complete_aliases set
Design directory linking assumes a root directory such as Dropbox or a server synced with rsync
